{"CommandLine":"cat << 'EOF' > scratch_test.lean
import Mathlib
import LeanProject.GraphInvariantsComputable

set_option maxRecDepth 10000

open SimpleGraph
open Finset

lemma eccentricity_le_of_ball_eq_univ {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (v : V) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ Fintype.card V) (hb : GraphCalc.ballWithin G m v = univ) :
    GraphCalc.eccentricity G v ≤ m := by
  unfold GraphCalc.eccentricity GraphCalc.minUpTo
  have hm_mem : m ∈ (range (Fintype.card V + 1)).filter (fun k => GraphCalc.ballWithin G k v = univ) := by
    rw [mem_filter, mem_range]
    exact ⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_le hm, hb⟩
  have h_min := Finset.min_le hm_mem
  cases h : (filter (fun k => GraphCalc.ballWithin G k v = univ) (range (Fintype.card V + 1))).min with
  | none =>
    exfalso
    exact Finset.min_eq_none.mp h (nonempty_of_mem hm_mem)
  | some val =>
    simp [h] at h_min ⊢
    exact h_min

lemma radius_le_of_eccentricity {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (v : V) : GraphCalc.radius G ≤ GraphCalc.eccentricity G v := by
  unfold GraphCalc.radius
  have hv : v ∈ (univ : Finset V) := mem_univ v
  have h_im : GraphCalc.eccentricity G v ∈ (univ : Finset V).image (GraphCalc.eccentricity G) :=
    mem_image_of_mem _ hv
  have h_min := Finset.min_le h_im
  cases h : ((univ : Finset V).image (GraphCalc.eccentricity G)).min with
  | none =>
    exfalso
    exact Finset.min_eq_none.mp h (nonempty_of_mem h_im)
  | some val =>
    simp [h] at h_min ⊢
    exact h_min

lemma radius_le_of_ball_eq_univ {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    (v : V) (m : ℕ) (hm : m ≤ Fintype.card V) (hb : GraphCalc.ballWithin G m v = univ) :
    GraphCalc.radius G ≤ m :=
  le_trans (radius_le_of_eccentricity G v) (eccentricity_le_of_ball_eq_univ G v m hm hb)
EOF
